items.title: Building Connections and Unlocking Growth Across Our Global Channel Partner Network
items.summary: trong partnerships are built on more than products. They are built on trust, collaboration, and a shared commitment to helping customers succeed. items.title: Why High-Performing Teams Still Need to Invest in Trust
items.summary: Many leadership teams assume that if they are delivering results, they already have everything they need to succeed. The reality is that even high-performing teams can become stronger. That was one of the key lessons from a recent Cohesive Teams experience involving a global leadership team responsible for supporting advanced surgical technologies. Although team members had worked together for years and maintained strong working relationships, the process revealed opportunities to deepen trust and improve communication to strengthen collaboration.

items.title: What the Culture Map Reinforced About Global Collaboration
items.summary: I've spent much of my career working with customers and teams across Europe, Asia, and the United States. Those experiences have taught me that successful collaboration depends as much on communication as it does on technical expertise. That's why I decided to take the Culture Map Assessment.

items.title: More Than an Acquisition: Celebrating a New Chapter Together
items.summary: When Riverpoint officially joined our company, we knew Day One should be more than an announcement. It should be a celebration. Riverpoint has built an impressive business through innovation and a culture of continuous improvement. Day One was an opportunity to celebrate those achievements and recognize the talented people behind them.

items.title: From Insight to Impact: Why Customer Intimacy Drives Innovation
items.summary: Most companies talk about customer focus. Fewer truly practice customer intimacy. There is a difference. Customer focus is responding to what customers ask for. Customer intimacy is understanding what they actually need, even before they say it.

items.title: Finding Belonging Far from Home: How Sharing Costa Rica Brought Us Closer Together
items.summary: When I moved from Costa Rica to Berlin, Germany, to join Novanta a year and a half ago, I was excited for a new adventure. What I did not expect was how meaningful it would be to one day stand in front of coworkers and share a piece of home with them. Recently, I had the opportunity to host a Costa Rica-themed event through our Multicultural employee resource group (ERG). What began as a cultural presentation became a powerful reminder of how much it means to feel seen, valued, and connected when you are far from home.

items.title: Building Capability for the Future: Why We Invested in a Real-Time Aging Chamber
items.summary: Several years ago, I started asking a question that many improvement projects begin with: Why are we doing it this way? The question centered on real-time aging studies, which are an essential part of demonstrating that medical products remain safe, effective, and compliant throughout their shelf life. At the time, much of that testing was performed externally, which meant additional costs and scheduling constraints, along with less flexibility.

items.title: Global Teams, Stronger Outcomes: How Cultural Differences Drive Better Execution
